profile.headline: System Software Engineer at Northwestern Mutual
profile.summary: Provide insightful advice and friendly hands-on technical support at various walk up locations.

positions.title: System Software Engineer III
positions.description:
-Administer and manage Zendesk, including user roles, automations, triggers, SLAs, workflows, and views, to support cross-functional teams and improve customer experience.
-Configure and customize ServiceNow modules to meet business requirements
-Develop and implement ServiceNow workflows, forms, and scripts
- Apply engineering standard methodologies to analyze and develop software solutions
- Leverages established coding standards, best practices, and automation capabilities to develop solutions to support our users
-Strive for continuous improvement on all aspects within the team and build continuous integration and continuous development pipeline (CI/CD)
-Identify technical problems and develop software solutions and automation capabilities
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Python (Programming Language) · Agile Methodologies · Zendesk · ServiceNow · ServiceNow Administration · Pandas (Software)

positions.title: Test Engineer II
positions.description: Skills: Kevlar · JavaScript · Cucumber · Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) · Mocha (JavaScript Framework) · Selenium WebDriver · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Associate Test Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Kevlar · JavaScript · Cucumber · Behavior-Driven Development (BDD)

positions.title: Sr. Field Help Desk Technician
positions.description: Provide friendly hands-on technical support at multiple walk up locations. Additional provide desktop support for hardware, software and computer peripherals.

positions.title: Senior Technical Support Analyst
positions.description:
Provide technical support for field representative

Primary Responsibilities:
-	Adaptable and flexible in changing work environments 
-	Excellent interpersonal and telephone etiquette 
-	Providing technical support for hardware and software support for Windows 7, 8, 10, iOS, Android and macOS 10.11
-	Demonstrate strong customer service both internally and externally
-	Experience using service management software to create, track and update tickets
-	Experience using knowledge base

positions.title: Service Desk Analyst (Tier 1)
positions.description:
Provide first level technical support for field representative’s across the country.

Primary Responsibilities:
   - New system setup and rebuilds for Windows 7 and 8
   - Local and Networked Printers
   - Mobile device and applications for iOS and Android
   -Passwords unlocks and reset
   -Vpn connectivity

positions.title: Service Technician
positions.description:
Provide computer hardware support for customer 

Primary Responsibilities:
     -Diagnose, repair and test computer hardware related to desktops and servers 
     -Test newly installed hardware in a unix environment
     -Image and Configure Windows Xp, Windows 7, and Windows Server (2008 and 2012)
     -Provide documentation on the repair process 
     -Create and maintain documents used internally to improve support for the customer
     -Work onsite with customer providing support for customer hardware

positions.title: Multi Purpose Worker
positions.description:
-Build, Test, Configure and troubleshoot for desktop, servers, printers 
-Support the production floor, manufacturing and engineering
-Knowledge of material process, rack integration assembly, and service desk 
-Good communications (in person, phone, email) working with different departments to resolve the conflict

positions.title: Production Technician
positions.description:
-Build, Test and Configure OEM computers for simulation, medical and security in a lean flow manufacturing
-Troubleshoot and escalate computer hardware and software through written and oral communication
-Review work and package system to customers standards in a timely manner

volunteerExperiences.description: Manage 200+ Eagle Scout Project working the Wisconsin State Department Natural Resources. The project was to install sign post and signs on Horse and Bike Trail at Lapham State Park

projects.title: AI Knowledge Recommendation System
projects.description: - Lead development of AI knowledge recommendation system to improve knowledge recommendation. Model predictions saw a three time improvements from the vendor.

projects.title: NLP Classification Model
projects.description:
- Lead development of a natural language process (nlp) / deep learning models to reduce agent handle time by ~3000 hours annually
- Poc was created to improve customer satisfaction and reduce handle time with the software
